results.collectionCensoredName: Forty Days of Silent Journey: A journey of spiritual awakening: forty days, forty moments of silence, forty encounters with God and with yourself
results.description:
Our days are loud. Silence can feel like something we have no time for. Forty Days of Silent Journey invites you to make room for it, one short day at a time.

Each day opens with a real-life story, names a struggle many of us share, and turns to a passage from Scripture. A short explanation and a simple prayer follow, and then a quiet moment to let the day settle. The forty days are arranged in six weeks. Each week has its own theme, from the silence that heals to learning to listen, meeting yourself, trusting in the dark, and words that bless. Together they lead you back into the world, ready to serve.

Each day takes about five minutes, so you can listen over morning coffee, on a commute or before sleep. It suits anyone who wants a gentler, deeper rhythm of prayer. It also works for small groups and families who want to share the journey and grow in faith together.

Written by Sabiocasa Press. Narrated by James Williams.
